events.title: Project: C.E.L.L. Weekly Devlog #5 - We Are Extremely Good at Weeks
events.summary: Hi everyone!First of all, sorry.Our last weekly devlog was on August 31.It is now October.We have recently discovered that this is not, technically, what “weekly” means.In our defense, we have been busy doing the thing these devlogs were supposed to be about: making the game.And after a month of balancing, polishing, fixing bugs, submitting things to Steam, waiting for Steam, checking Steamworks, pretending we weren’t checking Steamworks, and then checking Steamworks again...THE PROJECT: C.E.L.L

events.title: Project: C.E.L.L. Weekly Devlog #3
events.summary: Hi everyone! First of all, sorry this devlog is late. We know. We have once again discovered that “we’ll post it tomorrow” is a very dangerous sentence in game development. The good news is that we’ve been busy for a reason, here’s what we’ve been working on. events.title: Project: C.E.L.L. Weekly Devlog #1
events.summary: Hi everyone!It’s been a productive week for Project: C.E.L.L. We’ve added new music, renewed the skill tree, developed a balance-testing bot and continued getting the game ready for its first Steam Playtest.Here’s a look at what we’ve been working on. Music & Skill TreeOur musician finished six new gameplay tracks this week. Six. He’s an absolute beast, give him a task and he gets it done. At this point, we’ve stopped asking how.We’ve renewed the skill tree and created new icons for every skill.
